notes.title: Your invitation for "Pillowheads: It's Party Time"
notes.content:
Choose your Pillowhead... 
Sharpen your pencils... 
Get ready for the party!

The demo of Pillowheads will allow you to play unlimited sessions of Last Man Standing, a game mode where the last Pillowhead remaining on the field will win. 
But be warned: Defeated players can return if they successfully sabotage you from outside.

Enjoy the cheerful and colorful crafted Grassland where the sun always shows up to your party. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37956554/842074bcb5e1bf7e2a5b4f55692119e1cba5f042.gif


Up to 4 player can compete locally or via Remote Play Together against each other (or play against bots to practice for the next party.)

This demo is only showing a small slice of the game. 
Be prepared for more game modes, more maps and modificators which add variety by changing game rules. 
Visit our Store Page to find more information about the full game features!


We hope you will enjoy our game and wish you a lot of fun! 
- Your Pillowheads Dev Team


Follow us on Twitter!
Join the Pillowheads Discord server!

notes.title: Pillowheads at the Steam Game Festival 2020 Summer Edition
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We are very excited to be part of the Steam Game Festival starting on June 16th 2020! 

Get a chance to have a first look at Pillowheads with the demo:

Play unlimited sessions of the Last Man Standing game mode on our wonderful map Grassland! 

Up to 4 player can compete locally or via Remote Play Together (or play against bots to practice for the next party!)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37956554/01f7dac300ba4d019374b7b6fef2db26970f5659.jpg


We hope you will enjoy the game and have a lot of fun! 

- Your Pillowheads Dev Team
